hints.title: Group Posts by User
hints.text: Group the user posts by user identifier and aggregate post counts and distinct sentiments.

hints.title: Filter Single Sentiment and Minimum Count
hints.text: Use a group filter condition requiring count(distinct sentiment) = 1 and count(post_id) >= 3.

hints.title: Extract Sentiment Value
hints.text: Select min(sentiment) or max(sentiment) as the single consistent sentiment for qualifying users.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```sql
SELECT 
    user_id,
    MIN(sentiment) AS sentiment,
    COUNT(post_id) AS post_count
FROM UserPosts
GROUP BY user_id
HAVING COUNT(post_id) >= 3 
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT sentiment) = 1
ORDER BY user_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Group aggregation by user_id and sort.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Self-joining without aggregation fails to capture users with >= 3 posts cleanly.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash aggregation requires memory for unique users.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Expects clean HAVING clause with COUNT(DISTINCT sentiment) = 1.
